svg.metadata:
# looply 商品业务全流程系统流程图（红布林对接版 — 方案B） V6.0 # 研发编码参考数据，从 SVG <metadata> 提取
swimlanes: - key: "E" name: "红布林系统" - key: "A" name: "looply 商品业务层" - key: "B" name: "looply 商品系统" - key: "C" name: "looply 库存模块"
sections: - name: "① 商品数据同步" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品数据同步" - type: process lane: "E" text: "红布林通过Webhook推送商品数据" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "商品数据(品类/品牌/系列/成色/折扣价/图片URL)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "Webhook接收：签名验证(HMAC)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "幂等校验(Item ID + 事件ID去重)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "主数据映射：品牌/类目/系列原始值→looply主数据ID" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "映射全部成功?" on_no: "映射失败字段记入source_data" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "下载商品原图→存储到looply对象存储" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "写入product表(source='plum')" - type: condition_branch lane: "B" text: "映射结果?" yes_label: "映射成功" no_label: "有异常" yes_branch: - text: "product.status='待定价'" no_branch: - text: "product.status='映射异常'" - type: process lane: "B" text: "红布林原始数据完整保留到source_data(JSON)" - type: start_end text: "数据同步完成" - type: note title: "V6.0变更(对比V5.0)" lines: - "同步方式确认为红布林Webhook推送" - "新增主数据映射：红布林原始值→looply品牌/类目/系列ID" - "映射失败→product.status='映射异常'，运营补映射后重新处理" - "落库目标从独立暂存表改为product表(source='plum')" - "红布林原始数据(折扣价CNY/养护/改色等)存入source_data JSON" - name: "② 选品定价" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：选品定价(v2.10.3公式)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载product(status='待定价', source='plum')" - type: process lane: "A" text: "从source_data读取折扣价：A = 折扣价 / 6.86 (CNY→USD)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载TRR参考价(top_series+avg_prices)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "通过排除检查?" on_no: "排除(养护/改色/边油重做/折扣价无效)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "品牌/系列/尺码/成色匹配" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "属于可选品类目?" on_no: "不选中(服饰/鞋靴/腕表等)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "类目+系列分流?" branches: - label: "包袋Top系列" nodes: - type: process text: "公式3/1: B=ceil(1.46A+207)" - type: process text: "公式2/4: B=ceil(1.28A+181)" - type: process text: "公式5/7: B=ceil(1.22A+172)" - label: "包袋非Top/无均价" nodes: - type: process text: "公式6(自动选中)" - type: process text: "B=ceil(1.28A+181)" - label: "非包袋固定公式" nodes: - type: process text: "自动选中" - type: process text: "B=ceil(1.46A+207)" - label: "其他未命中" nodes: - type: process text: "不选中" - type: process lane: "A" text: "低价修正(公式2/4/5/6/7/非Top):B≤500→ceil(1.46A+207)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成选品预览(售价B/公式编号/选中/未选中原因)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "运营确认执行?" on_no: "取消" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "更新product定价结果" - type: process lane: "B" text: "选中→product.price_usd=B, status='已定价'" - type: process lane: "B" text: "不选中→product.status='已排除'" - type: start_end text: "选品定价完成" - type: note title: "定价特殊规则" lines: - "Speedy例外：B≤500时仍不选中(不做低价修正)" - "公式优先级：排除→Top系列→非Top→无系列无均价→非包袋→其他" - "Top系列公式判定顺序：3→1→2→4→5→7(按B与C的比值)" - "V6.0：定价结果直接写入product.price_usd，不导出Excel中转" - "V6.0：被排除商品显式标记status='已排除'" - name: "③ 商品翻译" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品翻译" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载product(status='已定价', source='plum')" - type: process lane: "A" text: "从source_data读取中文原始字段" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载4.3标准翻译数据(品牌/系列/颜色/尺码/材质/设计元素/附件/瑕疵/Category Suffix)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "前置清洗：空值统一处理/只取第一个颜色+材质+设计元素/去重相邻词" - type: process lane: "A" text: "逐字段中文→英文翻译(查4.3翻译表)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "获取Category Suffix(先查4.3→再查翻译后Category L3)" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "按类目组装Product Name?" branches: - label: "Handbags" nodes: - type: process text: "有系列非Wallet:系列+尺码+设计元素+材质+颜色" - type: process text: "有系列Wallet:同上+Category Suffix" - type: process text: "无系列:设计元素+材质+Suffix+尺码+颜色" - label: "Accessories" nodes: - type: process text: "有系列:系列+尺码+设计元素+材质+颜色+Suffix" - type: process text: "无系列:设计元素+材质+Suffix+尺码+颜色" - label: "Jewelry" nodes: - type: process text: "有系列:系列+设计元素+材质+颜色+Suffix+尺码" - type: process text: "无系列:设计元素+材质+颜色+Suffix+尺码" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "中文残留审计通过?" on_no: "标记warning" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "Cost Price转换：discount≤B保留原值,否则=discount/6.86" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "运营确认执行?" on_no: "取消" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "更新product翻译结果" - type: process lane: "B" text: "product.product_name_en=翻译结果, status='已翻译'" - type: start_end text: "商品翻译完成" - type: note title: "翻译特殊规则" lines: - "Wallet范围：Wallet/Passport Holder/Card Holder/Coin Purse/Key Pouch/Cosmetic Pouch" - "Wristlet不算Wallet，按Jewelry规则处理" - "Handbags有系列非Wallet时不追加Category Suffix" - "V6.0：翻译结果直接写入product.product_name_en" - name: "④ 商品上架" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品上架" - type: process lane: "A" text: "加载product(status='已翻译', source='plum')" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "关键字段校验通过?" on_no: "标记invalid(价格无效/名称缺失)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "查询该product是否已有listing" - type: condition_branch lane: "B" text: "已有listing?" yes_label: "已有" no_label: "没有" yes_branch: - text: "跳过(防止重复上架)" no_branch: - text: "标记ready,可上架" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "返回校验结果" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成预览清单(ready/skip/invalid)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "确认上架?" on_no: "取消" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "① 匹配/创建标品SKU" - type: condition_branch lane: "B" text: "SKU已存在?" yes_label: "已存在" no_label: "不存在" yes_branch: - text: "复用已有SPU" no_branch: - text: "创建标品SKU(brand+series+category+属性)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "关联product.spu_id" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "② 创建库存主体" - type: process lane: "C" text: "创建inventory_item(qty=1,二手商品)" - type: process lane: "C" text: "写入库存流水(INBOUND +1)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "③ 创建渠道商品" - type: process lane: "B" text: "创建listing(渠道+市场+挂牌价)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "关联图片(商品图+成色图+瑕疵图,保持源顺序)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "创建渠道库存分配" - type: process lane: "C" text: "创建channel_inventory_allocation" - type: process lane: "A" text: "④ 审计验证(4维回查)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "验证通过?" on_no: "标记失败,人工介入" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "更新product状态" - type: process lane: "B" text: "product.status='销售中'" - type: start_end text: "商品上架完成" - type: note title: "V6.0变更(对比V5.0)" lines: - "product在同步阶段已创建,上架不再创建实物商品" - "链路从5步简化为4步:匹配SPU→创建库存→创建listing→审计" - "冲突检测改为'是否已有listing'(external_item_id唯一性在同步时已保证)" - "checkpoint: sku_matched→inventory_created→listing_created→audit_done" - "审计4维: SPU关联+库存主体+渠道商品+库存分配(去掉'实物商品是否创建')" - name: "⑤ 商品售出" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：红布林售出通知" - type: process lane: "E" text: "红布林通知:商品已售出(商品ID)" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "售出通知(商品ID)" - type: process lane: "A" text: "Webhook接收：签名验证+幂等校验" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "查询product(external_item_id)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "返回product信息(status/spu_id/关联listing)" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "返回查询结果" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "product存在且有效?" on_no: "忽略(未同步/已售出)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "product有关联listing?" on_no: "仅更新product.status='已售出'" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "订单保护检查通过?" on_no: "有活跃订单,转异常处理" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "执行库存清零" - type: process lane: "C" text: "更新inventory_item(qty=0)" - type: process lane: "C" text: "写入库存流水(SOLD -1)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "释放渠道库存分配" - type: process lane: "C" text: "更新allocation(status=RELEASED)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "下架渠道商品+更新product" - type: process lane: "B" text: "listing.status='已下架'" - type: process lane: "B" text: "product.status='已售出'" - type: process lane: "A" text: "回查验证(多模块状态检查)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "验证通过?" on_no: "标记异常,人工介入" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: start_end text: "商品售出处理完成" - type: note title: "V6.0变更" lines: - "直接查product表，根据product.status判断处理方式" - "新增判断:product是否有关联listing(加工阶段的商品无listing，仅更新status)" - "不再经过暂存表中转" - name: "⑥ 商品状态变更" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：红布林状态变更通知" - type: process lane: "E" text: "红布林通知:商品状态变更(商品ID+新状态)" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "状态变更通知" - type: process lane: "A" text: "Webhook接收：签名验证+幂等校验" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "查询product(external_item_id)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "返回product信息(status/关联listing)" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "返回查询结果" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "product存在?" on_no: "忽略(商品未同步)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "product有关联listing?" on_no: "仅更新product.status" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "变更类型?" branches: - label: "红布林下架" nodes: - type: process text: "下架渠道listing(status=已下架)" - type: process text: "库存标记不可售(保留数量)" - type: process text: "product.status='已下架'" - label: "红布林重新上架" nodes: - type: process text: "恢复渠道listing(status=Active)" - type: process text: "库存恢复可售" - type: process text: "product.status='销售中'" - type: process lane: "A" text: "回查验证状态同步" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "验证通过?" on_no: "标记异常" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: start_end text: "状态变更处理完成" - type: note title: "V6.0变更" lines: - "直接更新product表，根据是否有listing决定是否联动" - "加工阶段的商品(待定价/已定价/已翻译)无listing，仅更新product.status" - "与售出区别:状态变更保留库存数量,售出则清零归档" - name: "⑦ 商品信息变更" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：红布林信息变更通知" - type: process lane: "E" text: "红布林通知:商品信息变更(商品ID+变更字段+新值)" - type: cross_lane from: "E" to: "A" text: "信息变更通知" - type: process lane: "A" text: "Webhook接收：签名验证+幂等校验" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "查询product(external_item_id)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "返回product当前数据(status/source_data)" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "返回查询结果" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "product存在?" on_no: "忽略(商品未同步)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "更新product.source_data(写入新原始值)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "source_data JSON更新变更字段" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "product已上架(有listing)?" on_no: "标记信息已更新,待后续加工时使用" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "变更类型?" branches: - label: "折扣价变更" nodes: - type: process text: "重算A=新折扣价/6.86" - type: process text: "重新执行定价公式→新售价B" - type: process text: "重算Cost Price" - label: "图片变更" nodes: - type: process text: "下载新图片→更新对象存储" - type: process text: "更新product.images+listing图片" - label: "品类/品牌/系列等" nodes: - type: process text: "重新映射主数据ID" - type: process text: "重新翻译→生成新Product Name" - type: process text: "品牌/系列变更可能触发重新定价" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "同步更新到product+listing" - type: process lane: "B" text: "写入变更后的数据" - type: process lane: "A" text: "回查验证信息一致" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "验证通过?" on_no: "标记异常" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: start_end text: "信息变更处理完成" - type: note title: "V6.0变更" lines: - "变更数据先更新product.source_data(JSON)，再决定联动" - "未上架商品(加工阶段):仅更新source_data，不触发重新定价/翻译" - "已上架商品:根据变更字段类型决定处理方式" - "折扣价变更→必须重新定价(A=折扣价/6.86, B=f(A))" - "品牌/系列变更→重新映射主数据+可能重新定价" - name: "⑧ 营销选品" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：营销选品" - type: process lane: "A" text: "运营设置筛选条件(类目/品牌/颜色/成色/价格区间等)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "查询product(status='销售中'+有listing)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "返回筛选结果列表" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "展示筛选结果" - type: process lane: "A" text: "运营勾选商品→加入选品篮(按variant维度)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "选品篮非空?" on_no: "提示选品篮为空" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: multi_branch lane: "A" text: "选择操作?" branches: - label: "导出Excel" nodes: - type: process text: "按选品篮生成Excel文件" - type: process text: "写入导出历史(可下载/删除)" - label: "批量打标签" nodes: - type: process text: "对选中商品执行tagsAdd" - type: process text: "回查确认tag已写入" - type: start_end text: "营销选品完成" - type: note title: "选品篮规则" lines: - "选品篮按variant维度保存,支持保存/清空/导出/打标签" - "导出文件进入历史记录,可下载/删除/清空" - "历史文件打标签用后台任务,选品篮打标签同步执行" - "筛选:状态/类目/品牌/系列/颜色/成色/价格区间/模板/文本搜索" - name: "⑨ 商品改价" steps: - type: start_end text: "开始：商品改价" - type: process lane: "A" text: "筛选product(status='销售中')→加载当前价格" - type: process lane: "A" text: "运营设定目标售价B(+可选Cost Price)" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "逐行匹配listing,获取当前价格" - type: process lane: "B" text: "返回匹配结果(当前price/compare-at/Cost Price)" - type: cross_lane from: "B" to: "A" text: "返回匹配数据" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "商品匹配且价格有效?" on_no: "标记无效(未匹配/B无效)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "按改价规则计算(涨价/降价/持平/等于compare-at)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "通过改价校验?" on_no: "不执行(降价差价不足30/无需变更)" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "生成改价预览(可处理/跳过/无效)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "运营确认执行?" on_no: "取消" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "B" text: "执行价格更新(price+compare-at price)" - type: process lane: "B" text: "更新listing价格" - type: cross_lane from: "A" to: "C" text: "更新Cost Price" - type: process lane: "C" text: "写入inventory item unitCost" - type: process lane: "A" text: "回读验证(price/compare-at/Cost Price)" - type: decision lane: "A" text: "验证通过?" on_no: "标记失败,记录原因" yes_label: "是" no_label: "否" - type: process lane: "A" text: "同步更新product.price_usd" - type: start_end text: "商品改价完成" - type: note title: "改价公式规则" lines: - "涨价: price改为target; 原compare-at高于target则保留,否则清空" - "降价: price改为target; compare-at取max(原price,原compare-at)" - "target等于compare-at: price改为target, 清空compare-at" - "target等于price: 价格不变" - "降价后compare-at与target差值不足30: 不执行" - "Cost Price: 提供且与当前不一致时写入unitCost"
svg.text: looply 商品业务全流程系统流程图（红布林对接版 — 方案B）
红布林通过Webhook推送商品数据
商品数据(品类/品牌/系列/成色/折扣价/图片URL)
幂等校验(Item ID + 事件ID去重)
主数据映射：品牌/类目/系列原始值→looply主数据ID
下载商品原图→存储到looply对象存储
红布林原始数据完整保留到source_data(JSON)
从source_data读取折扣价：A = 折扣价 / 6.86 (CNY→USD)
排除(养护/改色/边油重做/折扣价无效)
品牌/系列/尺码/成色匹配
不选中(服饰/鞋靴/腕表等)
生成选品预览(售价B/公式编号/选中/未选中原因)

涨价: price改为target; 原compare-at高于target则保留,否则清空
降价: price改为target; compare-at取max(原price,原compare-at)
target等于compare-at: price改为target, 清空compare-at
降价后compare-at与target差值不足30: 不执行
Cost Price: 提供且与当前不一致时写入unitCost
